title: Custom Hi-Fi Center Speaker Fabrication

information.value: Personal project completed during a BTS internship
Center speaker for Hi-Fi system / Complete design (woodworking, filter study, speaker tuning) / Custom handcrafted build / Optimized audio performance
Woodworking for cabinet fabrication / Study and design of passive audio filters / Acoustic tuning of the speaker / Optimization of sound performance

description: During my BTS internship, I took the opportunity in my free time to build a custom center speaker for a Hi-Fi system. The goal of this personal project was to create a speaker optimized for accurately reproducing dialogues and central sounds in a home audio setup.

I completed this project entirely on my own, handling every stage of the design process: from woodworking for the construction of the wooden cabinet to the study of the passive filter to ensure optimal distribution of sound frequencies between the speakers.

The tuning of the speaker was carefully studied to achieve a balanced sound output, with excellent reproduction of mid and high frequencies, which are essential for a center speaker dedicated to dialogue clarity.
This project allowed me to develop skills in acoustics, audio electronics, and mechanical design, while honing my techniques in woodworking and acoustic optimization.

The final speaker integrates seamlessly into a Hi-Fi system, offering clear and precise sound reproduction, demonstrating my ability to combine technical expertise with acoustic sensitivity in the design of audio equipment.
